synth.notes:
Render+re-extract: axis row band, holed 3x3-block pieces (holes transparent, 0 when selected), solid targets, gray reflections 2A-b skipping piece blocks; layers wall<target<reflection<piece, walls/players = comps of own colour + all 0 cells ranked by bbox.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces (size desc, min block) -> axis; A1/A2 move selection by a block row, A3/A4 move a selected piece by a block column; A7 undoes the last move but keeps the selection.
Step-64 mechanic: the budget bar (counter, row 63) stays at h=64 for 64 continuous actions (hidden reserve), then shrinks by 1 per action (y+1, h-1). A7 does not use budget.
Hypothesis, not confirmed: the depleted bar acts as one phantom player component ranked first, so piece names shift by +1 (walls, targets and reflections do not shift).
Stateless replay fails only steps 64 (needs the reserve count) and 70 (needs undo history). Both use hidden state that is only trusted while each input matches the last output.
